svg.title: Map of Bramble Farm
svg.text: Path: you can Sneak this way. No path, no way through.
Hayloft 3+ ×4: a hiding spot; roll 3+ to stay hidden; room for 4 turkeys.
Prank: its target, clock jump, and boxes.
NOISY: Sneak in on 3+. OPEN: no spots.
FARMER, DOG & KID, TURKEYS: where they start the game.
